Feature spotlight · Payments

Green Receipt Photos
on Bank Transfer

In Sudan most customers pay by bank transfer and the confirmation arrives as a green Bankak receipt. NovaPOS makes capturing it part of the sale — the transfer can't be confirmed without the photo.

1

Invoice → "Pay by Bank Transfer"

Cash totals confirm in one tap; transfers get a dedicated screen with a sticky total header.

2

"Take Receipt Photo"

Native camera on Android (Capacitor), file capture in the browser. Auto-compressed to ≤800px before upload.

3

Last 4 digits of the TXN ID

A 4-digit code ties the photo to the bank transaction. Confirm stays disabled until both photo + code are in.

4

Archived with the sale

The photo is stored server-side with the transaction and surfaces in Admin → Receipts — tap to expand, long-press to copy details.

Enforced client & server side Compressed ≤800px · q0.65 Offline-safe — queued & synced Idempotent retries (clientRef)

The receipt being captured →
Try the flow live: add items, tap Charge → Pay by Bank Transfer, shoot the green receipt, enter 7391, confirm — then find it in Admin → Receipts.

Feature spotlight · Admin

Admin Dashboard,
behind the password

Tap the 🔒 in the register header and sign in with admin / admin1234. The whole panel is JWT-guarded — the API routes refuse everything without it.

📈

KPIs & charts

Today / week / month revenue, revenue-over-time, payment split, top-10 products, cashier breakdown, busiest hours.

🖼️

Receipt-photo gallery

Every green transfer receipt in one wall — tap to expand full-screen, long-press to copy sale details.

📦

Catalog, cashiers & settings

Products with emoji + categories, per-cashier PINs, themes, receipt footer, session timeouts.

📊

.xlsx exports

Transactions and products workbooks with clean headers, column widths, date formatting and totals rows.

bcrypt + JWT (1h access / 7d refresh) Idle auto-logout Price snapshots on every sale Server-side money math
Walkthrough · The register

Cashier register — seconds per sale

Shift starts with a per-cashier PIN ("Who's working today?"). Products are one tap to add, long-press for a quantity dialog, cash confirms with a single button, transfers get the receipt-photo flow.

Offline queue — sales park on-device & auto-sync Basket survives cashier switch 48dp+ touch targets · haptics Custom modals — never alert()
Walkthrough · Admin toolkit

Everything the back office needs

Seven tabs behind the password: Dashboard, Products, Categories, Cashiers, Transactions, Receipts and Settings — with bulk actions, drag-reorder categories, voids and .xlsx exports.
